web.description:
# Registering for GST
## When you need to register
- when your business or enterprise has a GST turnover (gross income from all businesses minus GST) of $75,000 or more (the [GST threshold](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/gst-excise-and-indirect-taxes/gst/registering-for-gst#GSTTurnover)). To find out how this is calculated see [Working out your GST turnover](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/gst-excise-and-indirect-taxes/gst/registering-for-gst#WorkingoutyourGSTturnover).

web.title: When and how to report and pay GST | Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# When and how to report and pay GST
## When to report
- [Annually](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/gst-excise-and-indirect-taxes/gst/when-and-how-to-report-and-pay-gst/annual-gst-reporting) if you are voluntarily registered for GST. That is, you are registered for GST and your GST turnover is under $75,000 ($150,000 for not-for-profit bodies).

web.title: How to Register for GST in Australia: When You Must and How to Do It
web.description:
# How to Register for GST in Australia: When You Must and How to Do It
### Overview
Most businesses must register for GST once their annual turnover reaches $75,000, although some industries, such as ride-sharing, must register from their first dollar of income.

## When Is GST Registration Compulsory in Australia?
- Your current or projected annual GST turnover is $75,000 or more

## How to Register for GST in Australia: Step-by-Step
4. Select your preferred BAS reporting cycle: quarterly (most common), monthly, or annually (if turnover is under $10 million and you elect to do so).

## How GST Works for Different Business Types
### eCommerce and Shopify Sellers
Australian eCommerce sellers must register and charge GST once their turnover reaches $75,000.

## Frequently Asked Questions
##### #### When do I have to register for GST?
You must register for GST when your current or projected annual turnover reaches $75,000 (or $150,000 for not-for-profits).

# Registering for GST and other taxes
## Goods and services tax
### Register for GST
- your business or enterprise has a GST turnover of $75,000 or more a year (the [GST threshold](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/gst-excise-and-indirect-taxes/gst/registering-for-gst#GSTTurnover)) – to find out how this is calculated, see [Working out your GST turnover](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/gst-excise-and-indirect-taxes/gst/registering-for-gst#WorkingoutyourGSTturnover)
